safety.title: How your files are kept safe

agentFolders.title: Agent folders
agentFolders.body: {{app}} never overwrites or deletes anything in an agent's folder that it did not put there; a clash is reported with the exact path instead. A folder several agents share is cleaned up only when none of them still uses it.

editor.title: Editing
editor.body: A save never overwrites a change made on disk after you opened the file: you see both and choose. Every save keeps the version it replaced (the last 20), and unsaved text survives closing the window.

copies.title: Copies in agent folders
copies.body: Saving a library skill refreshes its copies, except a copy that was changed in the agent's folder: that one is left alone and reported.

updates.title: Updates
updates.body: Before an update deletes a file you see which ones and approve. Automatic updates never delete files, and hold back skills you edited.

backup.title: Backup
backup.body: A conflict never blocks a sync: your version stays until you choose, and a safety snapshot is taken first. Restoring a snapshot saves the current state first. Your GitHub token is encrypted with the system keychain.

library.title: Your data
library.body: Everything lives in ~/.loadout. Moving the library goes only into an empty folder and moves all or nothing. Removing all data takes {{app}}'s links out of agent folders first and never touches project folders.
